column1: By 1945 the Leibstandarte had been successfully moved east by train to Vienna, and the difficult task of rebuilding the division began.  The situation for Germany was critical - Budapest had fallen after a 51 day seige; Warsaw, Lodz and Krakow had fallen; a Soviet Army was in East Prussia; the Red Army was now a mere 200km from Prague, and worst of all, it had crossed the river Oder, and was only 70km from Berlin.  The I SS Panzer Corps was to be used to rectify this critical situation.
column2: 到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、利茨曼施塔特(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。|到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、罗兹(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。

column1: Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.
column2: 将军同志，「堡垒」(Zitadelle)攻势已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。|将军同志，「库尔斯克会战」(Zitadelle)已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。

column1: Comrade General you have failed to destroy the Italian Eighth Army! The Germans still threaten to release Sixth Army! Vassiliev is very disatisfied!
column2: 将军同志，你未能消灭意大利第8集团军！德国人仍威胁着为第6集团军解围！瓦西里耶夫极为不满！|普罗霍罗夫卡

column1: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!! For your courage you've been again awarded with the Hero of the Soviet Union. Hurrah!!!
column2: 二战 1/2：反击- 挡格|将军同志，为表彰你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的建议，把突击柏林的任务交给了你！！！由于你的英勇，你再次被授予苏联英雄称号。乌拉！！！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Koenigsberg and Danzig have lived, Kaliningrad and Gdansk are born, our borders are now secured for a long time!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！柯尼斯堡(Koenigsberg)与但泽(Danzig)已经消亡，加里宁格勒(Kaliningrad)与但泽(Gdansk)就此诞生，我们的边界将长期安全！！！|将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！柯尼斯堡(Koenigsberg)与但泽(Danzig)已经消亡，加里宁格勒(Kaliningrad)与格但斯克(Gdansk)就此诞生，我们的边界将长期安全！！！

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
column2: 南乌克兰集团军群(Army Group Southern Ukraine) (#12) - 1944 年 8 月 7 日|将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯分子逐出立陶宛(Lithuania)、并在东普鲁士打开通往德国本土之路的机会！你将指挥波罗的海第1方面军(First Baltic Front)！

column1: Excellent! your actions were better than we had expected, you will receive much prestige to reclaim some transport to your units plus any upgrade you may do.
column2: 先头部队(Advanced Elements) - 1940 年 10 月 11 日|太好了！你的行动比我们预期的更好，你将获得大量威望，可为部队补充一些运输工具，还可进行任何你想要的升级。

column1: Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你设法守住了防线，甚至把那些赤色分子打退了几英里。|彼得库夫(Piotrkow) - 1939 年 9 月 7 日

column1: Great job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed along with a substantial portion of the garrison force in Greece.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。虽然希腊已经陷落，但那些潜艇以及希腊驻军的一大部分都已被消灭。|行军命令

column1: Great job, Commander! The missiles are neutralized, and we push towards Moscow! Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons...
column2: 塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol) (#5) - 1942 年 6 月 7 日|干得漂亮，指挥官！导弹已被摧毁，我们向莫斯科推进！希望斯大林没有更多秘密武器了……

column1: Great Job, Moscow is now back to normal and Comrade Stalin is safe thanks to your intervention.
column2: 干得漂亮，莫斯科(Moscow)现已恢复正常，多亏你的出手，斯大林同志安然无恙。|库尔斯克 (#16v)

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。|将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。|将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，塔尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。|将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。

column1: Kongratulieren!, now the Suez Kanal is under German control!, this will be a useful help also for our Japanese friends.
column2: 克林(Klin) (ZS#00)，1941 年 12 月 6 日|恭喜！苏伊士运河(Suez Kanal)现在已在德国控制之下！这对我们的日本朋友也会是有用的帮助。

column1: Outstanding work, General.  You have displayed superior tactics and abilities.  I will recommend a promotion to your superiors.  Keep up the good work and advance to the battlefield at Spanish Pass.
column2: 二战1/2：向柏林前进|干得漂亮，将军。你展现了高超的战术与才能。我会向你的上级建议晋升。继续努力，开赴西班牙山口(Spanish Pass)战场。
圣洛(St. Lo) - 眼镜蛇行动 PeG|西线-27 圣洛(St. Lo) - 眼镜蛇行动 PeG

column1: Strock: Herr General or better ex-Herr General war it is a tough business.You should try another occupation.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。|沃洛科拉姆斯克

column1: Strock: Herr General, we have a pressing situation with Poland. For months now, the Führer has been trying to negotiate with them a generous settlement regarding Katowitz and Danzig. Since they have numerous allies on their side, including England, they have been very unreasonable and unrelenting in their demands. Several days ago, they have gotten so arrogant that they crossed our border at several places. The Führer felt obligated that in order to preserve the freedom of our citizens, we have to strike back. I want you to go forth with such force that they, and any future aggressors, will see that we will not be pushed into submission.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们在波兰问题上面临紧迫局势。数月来，元首一直在就卡托维兹(Katowitz)与但泽(Danzig)问题与他们商谈一项宽厚的解决方案。由于他们那边有众多盟友，包括英格兰，他们的要求一直极不讲理、毫不松口。几天前，他们变得如此狂妄，竟在几处越过了我们的边界。元首感到有义务回击，以保全我们公民的自由。我要你以如此强大的力量出击，让他们以及任何未来的侵略者都看到，我们绝不会被逼屈服。|施特罗克：将军阁下，我们在波兰问题上面临紧迫局势。数月来，元首一直在就卡托维茨(Katowitz)与但泽(Danzig)问题与他们商谈一项宽厚的解决方案。由于他们那边有众多盟友，包括英格兰，他们的要求一直极不讲理、毫不松口。几天前，他们变得如此狂妄，竟在几处越过了我们的边界。元首感到有义务回击，以保全我们公民的自由。我要你以如此强大的力量出击，让他们以及任何未来的侵略者都看到，我们绝不会被逼屈服。

column1: The Central Committee is very displeased.  Leningrad continues to suffer under enemy bombardment.  You are clearly unfit to lead troops into combat.  Report at once to Ulyanovsk.  A detachment of Red Octobrists are waiting for you to join them.
column2: 中央委员会极为不满。列宁格勒(Leningrad)仍在敌军轰炸下受苦。你显然不适合带兵作战。立即前往乌里扬诺夫斯克(Ulyanovsk)报到。一支红色十月分队正等着你加入。|红色浪潮涌起

column1: The German army has made significant progress.  Your PanzerKorps must complete an encirclement by capturing Ternopil' from the east.  Of course, in the process, destroy the Soviet forces defending it.
column2: 德军已取得重大进展。你的装甲军必须从东面夺取塔尔诺波尔(Ternopil')，以完成合围。当然，在此过程中还要消灭守御该地的苏军。|德军已取得重大进展。你的装甲军必须从东面夺取捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')，以完成合围。当然，在此过程中还要消灭守御该地的苏军。

column1: to capture the Soviet controlled city of Kishinev.
column2: 以夺取苏联控制的基什尼奥夫(Kishinev)城。|以夺取苏联控制的基希讷乌(Kishinev)城。

column1: Victory!!!, the British have been kicked from another place more!. Now, the Mediterranean is closed, and the South Bank is secured. Of course, we will put a permanent garrison in Spain, surely this won't please to Franco, but... this is not important! HAHAHAHAHA!
column2: 波美拉尼亚壁垒(Wal Pomorski) -「波美拉尼亚阵地」(Pommernstellung)|胜利！！！英国人又被我们从一个地方踢了出去！现在，地中海已经封闭，南岸也已确保。当然，我们会在西班牙驻一支永久守备部队，这肯定不讨佛朗哥(Franco)喜欢，但……这不重要！哈哈哈哈哈！

column1: We really needed a knockout blow here, Commander.  Instead, you put up a weak little jab.  Our boys are fighters, but we need a general who can lead them!  Son, I put a lot of faith in your abilities... I was wrong, Commander.  It's time to send you back home.
column2: 从莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)到温莎(Windsor)：|我们这里真正需要的是一记击倒对手的重拳，指挥官。可你却打出一记软弱无力的小刺拳。我们的小伙子都是战士，但我们需要一位能带领他们的将军！孩子，我曾对你的能力寄予厚望……我错了，指挥官。该送你回家了。
北非-17 欢迎来到塞维利亚(Sevilla)，将军。|欢迎来到塞维利亚(Sevilla)，将军。

column1: Well, The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.
column2: 好，总参谋部对你的表现感到满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。你在战场上的能力持续令敌人困惑。|芬兰人完蛋了？

column1: You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your horrible actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这糟糕的行动毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！|华沙-波兹南行动 (RTB#30)

column1: You have failed miserably.  Rommel remains dominant in North Africa and Egypt is now sure to fall. Report for reassignment immediately!
column2: 你败得很惨。隆美尔(Rommel)仍主宰着北非(North Africa)，埃及(Egypt)如今必定陷落。立即报到接受改派！|渡过沃尔图诺河

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  Hey, rumor has it the president may want to pin a medal on you himself.
column2: 亚眠(Amiens) - 1946 年 1 月 5 日|好了，指挥官，干得漂亮！那些德国佬到死都不知道是什么打中了他们。是啊，多亏了你，我们的处境真不错。嘿，有传言说总统可能想亲自给你别上一枚勋章。
column4: 各译法无共同汉字 ⇒ 语境不同（scopes=PEGWW2_SCN|PEGWW2_SCN_OVR）

column1: Brilliant work Commander!  You have exceeded our expectations.
column2: 加扎拉防线(Gazala Line)（「忒修斯」行动(Operation Theseus)）|干得漂亮，指挥官！你超出了我们的期望。
column4: 各译法无共同汉字 ⇒ 语境不同（scopes=PEGWW2_SCN|PEGWW2_SCN_OVR）

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling. I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough.
column2: 二战 1/2：突入波兰|指挥官，付出如此代价走到这一步，却功败垂成，实在令人恼恨。我不怀疑你已经尽了全力，但遗憾的是，尽力还不够。
column4: 各译法无共同汉字 ⇒ 语境不同（scopes=PEGWW2_SCN|PEGWW2_SCN_OVR）

column1: Commander, you have delayed the enemy long enough to allow our evacuation at Dunkirk. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
column2: 指挥官，你拖延敌人的时间已足以让我们在敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)完成撤离。我们承受不起继续遭受这样的损失。我们对你的期望要高得多。|温泉关

column1: Commander, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, German forces have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of weather stations in Greenland.  Dismissed.
column2: 托布鲁克|指挥官，你勉强达成了目标。遗憾的是，德军得以秩序井然地撤走，并在新的防线后方重新集结。你显然患上了战斗应激，将被调去监督格陵兰(Greenland)气象站的建设。解散。
column4: 各译法无共同汉字 ⇒ 语境不同（scopes=PEGWW2_SCN|PEGWW2_SCN_OVR）

column1: Communism is no longer a threat for Western Europe thanks to you Commander.
column2: 多亏了你，指挥官，共产主义对西欧(Western Europe)不再是威胁。|温莎(Windsor)：

column1: Comrade General you have achieved complete victory! The German are retreating towards the Dnepr river at full speed! We have them on the run!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了完全的胜利！德国人正全速向第聂伯河(Dnepr)撤退！我们把他们打跑了！|阿杰达比亚(Agedabia) - 1945 年 12 月 23 日
